name: @olai/format
//exports: Two entries, and the second is not product. The `./testlib` subpath is the fixture builder this package's own tests are written against, published so a package ABOVE can write its fixtures the same way — the alternative was @olai/ops growing a byte-identical copy of the same diagnostic, which is exactly the drift src/fixtures.testlib.ts was consolidated to stop.
//dependencies: The bottom of the layering (docs/architecture.md): nothing here can reach a disk, a server or a browser. A workspace sibling appearing here would be a layering violation, and `bun install` is what would report it. fastest-levenshtein is the did-you-mean distance — a focused, dependency-free library rather than eighteen lines of textbook matrix arithmetic we would then own.
